kind: Read-only tracked-source delivery audit and offline active dependency-graph validation; no build or browser execution
provenanceNote: The original source/path/include/font/symlink audit and offline five-target graph command ran at 3d7b8fc6. The listed git objects prove its build inputs are identical to c549. The whole pinned c549 tree LFS-prefix scan and equivalence comparison were performed when recording this evidence. Numeric observations are retained from those actual checks; no archive rebuild was performed.

trackedTree.lfsScanMethod: Enumerate the pinned c549 git tree. Read the first 200 bytes of unchanged working-tree files; for files changed since c549, inspect the pinned blob itself. Check the standard Git LFS version prefix. Symlink blobs are handled separately.

cargoPathClosure.scope: Conservative normal/build path dependencies across all target conditions and optional edges; development-only edges are not traversed. Workspace-inherited paths are resolved from their workspace root. This source closure is separate from active-feature graph validation. Literal include_bytes!/include_str! paths in the tracked Rust files are checked; generated OUT_DIR references are not classified as missing source.

activeRendererGraphCheck.scope: cargo tree --locked for normal/build edges only; no compilation or network access

publicApiReview.browser: BrowserPlatformOptions selects BrowserRenderer::Vello; explicit surfaces are WebGL2 or Software2D. Browser crate default Skia feature is disabled by the app manifest.
publicApiReview.native: VelloApplicationExtensions configures Hybrid/Cpu through public platform builders.
publicApiReview.drawing: Application artwork uses FerroUI DrawingContext, geometry/brush/text APIs, public compositing layers and RenderTargetBitmap.
publicApiReview.fixtureNote: The native regression font under src/Skia/FerroUI.Skia/test_assets is a tracked font fixture, not an active renderer dependency.

buildFromExtractedSource.macosNativeSourceFallback: src/FerroUI.Native/build.rs uses ../../native/FerroUI.Native if its local native link is not a directory.

Pinned wasm-bindgen release or locked Cargo installation
npm dependencies, including the pinned public GitHub native-file-system-adapter source

browserArtifactRequirements.generatedModules: Verify every static import from host/application and generated snippets plus the exact referenced WASM filename.
browserArtifactRequirements.dynamicModule: Check storage.js explicitly: dynamic import is not covered by the existing static-only traversal.
browserArtifactRequirements.fonts: Six Inter TTFs are embedded in the native module; no separate dist/fonts directory is required.
browserArtifactRequirements.manifest: Verify exact source/tree/toolchain, complete payload file set and every size/SHA256.
browserArtifactRequirements.runtimeNetworkScope: No mandatory external runtime font, stylesheet or CDN was found in the inspected app host path. Serve the complete distribution over HTTP; source-build downloads are separate.

limitations: No independently downloaded source ZIP was extracted, CRC-checked or built in this audit.
Source closure and offline graph validation do not establish compilation, browser behavior, visual parity or performance.
The no-.git conclusion is based on inspected repository build logic, not an archive rebuild; setup still requires the git executable to clone Emscripten.

The initial tree audit was at 3d7b8fc6; the listed object equality establishes the c549 application/framework input correspondence. Later documentation/CI-only commits are not relabeled as an executed c549 build.
